description: This PHP script interacts with the TestLink API to create and manage test cases via XML-RPC calls. It includes functions to initialize test cases with various parameters, such as name, summary, steps, and status, and performs multiple API calls using the IXR_Client class.

classes.name: IXR_Client
classes.description: A client class used to communicate with the XML-RPC server, including debugging capabilities.

methods.name: runTest
methods.description: Function to execute a test case via the IXR_Client with specified method and arguments.
